name: Banks - PSU

mofsl_2qfy27.headline: FINANCIALS - BANKS: Healthy growth outlook; NIM trends divergent; asset quality improves
mofsl_2qfy27.read: PSU bank NII grew 14.6% YoY and 5.2% QoQ, all PSBs reported sequential NII growth, and NIMs rose 2-8bp QoQ (BOB down 3bp) on better advance yields and limited FCNR(B) liquidity. PSU operating profit grew 12.0% YoY but fell 2.1% QoQ because SBI's operating profit dropped 19.7% QoQ; PAT grew 11.3% YoY (INR429b), led by BOB (+35.8% YoY). MOFSL expects PSBs to compound earnings at ~11% CAGR over FY26-28E, lagging private banks (22% vs 11% on its numbers), with 10-15bp of steady-state ECL cost a drag; SBIN guides FY27 credit growth of 14-15%, domestic NIM of at least 3%, RoA ~1% and RoE ~15%.

unit_economics: RoA = NII/assets + core fees/assets - opex/assets - credit cost/assets, plus a large non-core layer (treasury, written-off recoveries, stake gains) that is 24% of PBT at PSU banks against 7% at private banks; RoE comes from 13-18x leverage on about half the private-bank RoA.

price_drivers.driver: Quality of earnings: non-core share of PBT
price_drivers.why: Treasury plus written-off recoveries are ~24% of FY26 PBT at PSU banks; as recovery pools shrink and excess SLR depletes, reported RoA falls toward core RoA of 0.8-1.0%.
PSU NIM rose 2-8bp QoQ in Q2FY27 and only ~53-54% of the floating book is EBLR-linked, so the hike lifts yields with less lag on deposits than at private banks.
MOFSL cites a 10-15bp steady-state ECL impact; day-1 shortfalls are largest at Canara and Bank of India where floating buffers are thin.
GNPA falls partly through write-offs; MOFSL notes agri stress in drought pockets and PSU credit costs rising from lower write-back support.
GoI stake, minimum public shareholding, dividend matrix and wage settlement due Nov-2027 shape equity supply and staff cost.

kpis.name: NIM (global and domestic, ex tax-refund interest)
kpis.definition: Net interest income over average interest-earning assets, with domestic NIM shown to strip low-margin overseas books and income-tax-refund interest removed.
kpis.formula: (NII - IT-refund interest - recovered interest on written-off accounts) / average interest-earning assets, annualised
kpis.why_it_moves_price: PSU NIM moves less than private NIM in both directions because only ~53-54% of floating loans are EBLR-linked; MOFSL saw 2-8bp QoQ expansion in Q2FY27 and SBIN guides domestic NIM of at least 3%.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation with metric filter 'NIM' (global, domestic, overseas); get_financials for NII and assets; Motilal Oswal results tables in the report library.
kpis.estimate_source: No consensus field for NIM; use broker models (Motilal Oswal, Kotak IE, IIFL), company NIM guidance from transcripts (SBIN domestic NIM at least 3%); get_consensus_estimates for PAT/EPS/BVPS only.
kpis.traps: IT-refund interest (BOB, Union, Canara) and recovered interest inflate NII and some banks stopped disclosing it; overseas NIMs of 1.1-1.7% dilute global NIM; Indian books refund interest in other income.

kpis.name: Non-core share of PBT
kpis.definition: Written-off recoveries, treasury (FVTPL) gains, stake-sale gains, IT-refund interest and SR write-backs as a share of profit before tax.
kpis.formula: (P&L TWO recoveries + treasury + stake gains + IT refund + SR write-backs) / PBT
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Above 25% the headline RoA overstates the sustainable level; MOFSL shows SBIN operating profit down 19.7% QoQ when treasury and one-offs reversed, which is the pattern the multiple discounts.
kpis.history_source: get_financials (other income, provisions, treasury lines); get_investor_presentation with metric filter 'recovery' and 'trading gains'; annual report via list_library_documents for the written-off pool.
kpis.estimate_source: No consensus; build from broker models (Motilal Oswal, IIFL) and recovery guidance from transcripts (e.g. PNB, Indian Bank recovery targets).
kpis.traps: Three different recovery numbers (P&L line, deck incl. interest, AR pool roll-forward); stake gains booked through P&L, AFS reserve or capital reserve depending on bank (BOB NSE through P&L, SBI NSE to reserve).

kpis.name: Gross slippage ratio and write-offs to slippage
kpis.definition: Fresh NPAs over opening advances, tracked beside write-offs over slippages to test whether GNPA improvement is real.
kpis.formula: Gross slippage x 4 / opening gross advances; write-offs / gross slippage over four quarters
kpis.why_it_moves_price: A GNPA decline with write-offs above slippage is clean-up not improvement, and agri slippages (drought, SLBC restructuring) hit in Q2 and Q4 classification windows.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation with metric filter 'slippages' and 'write-off'; get_financials for GNPA; Motilal Oswal results tables.
kpis.estimate_source: No consensus; broker asset-quality tables (Motilal Oswal) and management slippage guidance from transcripts; SBI discloses net slippage only after Q1.
kpis.traps: SBI slippages are net of recoveries and upgrades; PSU agri GNPA of 7.5%; technical write-offs; crop loans classified half-yearly.

kpis.name: ECL day-1 shortfall net of buffers, % of net worth
kpis.definition: Management's estimate of the post-tax day-1 expected-credit-loss shortfall on 1-Apr-2027 over existing floating and other buffers, as a share of net worth.
kpis.formula: (ECL day-1 estimate - usable buffers) x (1 - tax) / net worth
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Above ~8% of net worth the bank is an equity-raise risk; MOFSL's 10-15bp steady-state ECL cost also cuts forward RoA, and estimates have risen quarter to quarter at Canara.
kpis.history_source: Transcripts via search_research and get_qa (ECL commentary by quarter); get_investor_presentation with metric filter 'ECL' or 'floating provision'; annual report for buffers.
kpis.estimate_source: No consensus field; company ECL estimates from transcripts and broker notes (Motilal Oswal, ICICI Securities, Systematix); bases differ (SBI post-tax net, others pre-tax gross).
kpis.traps: Estimates drift and are pre- or post-tax; HTM fair-value loss sometimes excluded; floating provisions counted in NNPA and again as an ECL offset.

kpis.name: Credit cost (house basis, gross of written-off recoveries shown too)
kpis.definition: Specific, NFB and standard-asset provisions over average advances, with written-off recoveries shown beside it because large pools flatter reported cost.
kpis.formula: (specific + NFB-NPA + standard provisions) / average gross advances, annualised; also net of faded recoveries
kpis.why_it_moves_price: MOFSL flags relatively high PSU credit costs from incremental ECL; recovery-netted credit cost of 17bp at SBI and BOB looks benign but depends on the written-off pools shrinking.
kpis.history_source: get_financials (provisions); get_investor_presentation with metric filter 'credit cost'; Motilal Oswal results tables.
kpis.estimate_source: Broker models (Motilal Oswal, Kotak IE, IIFL) and management guidance from transcripts; no consensus field.
kpis.traps: Canara and Union show income tax inside 'provisions'; PNB P&L credit cost of ~3bp vs management 25bp after a provision release; floating and prudential provision builds.

kpis.name: CASA ex-FCNR, government deposits and bulk share
kpis.definition: Domestic CASA ratio after removing FCNR(B), with government and institutional savings and tiered bulk savings shown inside it.
kpis.formula: (CA + SA - FCNR(B)) / domestic deposits; bulk + CDs / domestic deposits
kpis.why_it_moves_price: PSU deposit share has fallen from 61% (FY21) to ~56% (FY26); CASA that includes government and bulk-tier balances is less sticky than the headline suggests.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation with metric filter 'CASA'; get_financials for deposits; provisional business updates through search_research.
kpis.estimate_source: Management commentary from transcripts and broker models (Motilal Oswal, Nomura); no consensus field. SBI publishes no provisional update.
kpis.traps: FCNR(B) gross-up (BOB CASA 36.4% reported vs 39.1% ex-FCNR); SBI refuses bulk share; global vs domestic denominators.

kpis.name: Provision coverage ex-TWO and SMA
kpis.definition: Specific provisions over GNPA excluding technically written-off accounts, with CRILC SMA pools beside it.
kpis.formula: Specific provisions / GNPA (ex-TWO); SMA-1 and SMA-2 as % of standard loans
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Falling PCR ex-TWO with NNPA above 0.4% signals thin cover into ECL; PCR is the buffer the market watches when GNPA keeps falling.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation with metric filter 'PCR' and 'SMA'; get_financials for NPA data.
kpis.estimate_source: No consensus; broker asset-quality tables (Motilal Oswal) and management PCR targets from transcripts.
kpis.traps: PCR incl. TWO runs 92-97% vs 74-90% ex-TWO; prudential provisions inflate PCR (BOB); write-off timing.

kpis.name: CET1 and equity supply (GoI stake, QIP/OFS)
kpis.definition: CET1 ratio after ECL glide and the equity needed for growth or minimum public shareholding.
kpis.formula: CET1 reported; GoI holding %; supply needed to reach 25% public float / free-float value
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Banks above 75% GoI face discounted issuance that unwinds scarcity premia; growth guidance of 14-25% needs capital at Canara (lowest CET1) and others.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation with metric filter 'CET1'; shareholding from get_financials or company filings; annual report for enabling resolutions.
kpis.estimate_source: Management capital-raise commentary in transcripts; broker capital notes; no consensus field.
kpis.traps: RBI Nov-2025 option lets revaluation reserve and DTA count in CET1; RBI observations at Indian Bank cut CRAR; interim profit inclusion.

macro_inputs.source: RBI statements; transcripts in Airavat for EBLR/MCLR mix commentary
macro_inputs.why: EBLR is ~53-54% of PSU floating loans, so the hike passes through with a lag via MCLR.

macro_inputs.source: Market data outside Airavat commodity tools
macro_inputs.why: Treasury MTM falls and AS-15 pension discount rate rises together, a partial natural hedge.

macro_inputs.source: IMD and state SLBC notices; broker sector notes in report library
macro_inputs.why: MOFSL cites localised drought pockets; agri slippage follows in Q2/Q4 classification.
Funds treasury income at SBI and BOB; its depletion removes a profit leg.
Next settlement due 1-Nov-2027 steps up staff cost in FY28.

valuation_anchor: P/B and P/ABV against core RoE, with SBIN as core bank at 1.05-1.5x plus a SOTP for listed subsidiaries (SBI Cards, SBI Life, SBI Funds) and mid PSU banks at 0.6-1.5x one-year-forward ABV; ABV net of NNPA, subsidiary carrying value and post-tax ECL shortfall.
watch_next_quarter: Watch whether PSU NIMs expand after the repo hike, SBIN's operating profit recovering from the 19.7% QoQ fall, credit cost against MOFSL's 10-15bp steady-state ECL view, and agri slippages in drought-hit portfolios; MOFSL keeps SBIN as a preferred pick and Bank of Baroda was the PSU surprise.
